title: Root disk full from unrotated debug logs
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web/API component, disk‑full problem, and the new cron job as the trigger.
option_titles: Disable job, move log, restart API
Disable job and move log only
root_cause: The newly added cron job 'collect-debug-logs' writes API debug dumps to /var/log/shop/debug.log, which grew to 17.5 GB and filled the root filesystem, preventing the API container from writing its logs and causing 500 errors.
truth: A new cron job 'collect-debug-logs' was added two days ago. It writes verbose debug output to /var/log/shop/debug.log but the logrotate config was not updated for this file, so the log grows unbounded. The root disk (/) reached 97% used, leaving no space for nginx to write its access log or for the api container to write its log, causing 500 errors on all dynamic requests.
